name: LPF1
description: First-order one-pole low-pass filter. Gentle 6 dB/octave roll-off — ideal as a smoothing stage or for taking the edge off bright sources without colouring the resonance. From sc3-plugins BerlachUGens.

name: LPF18
description: Three-pole resonant low-pass filter with non-linear distortion stage modelled after the Moog ladder. The dist parameter drives the internal feedback path, producing softly saturating resonance. From sc3-plugins BerlachUGens.

inputs.name: res
inputs.description: Resonance amount (0 to 1) — values approaching 1 self-oscillate

inputs.name: dist
inputs.description: Distortion drive applied inside the feedback path (0 to 1)

name: LPFVS6
description: Variable-slope six-pole low-pass filter. The slope input morphs the response between gentle and steep cut-off without retuning the cutoff frequency. From sc3-plugins BerlachUGens.

inputs.name: slope
inputs.description: Filter slope (0 to 1) — higher values increase the roll-off steepness

name: BLBufRd
description: Band-limited buffer reader using a windowed-sinc interpolation kernel. Cleaner than BufRd's linear/cubic interpolation when reading at non-integer rates — drastically reduces aliasing when pitching buffers up. From sc3-plugins BerlachUGens.

inputs.name: ratio
inputs.description: Pitch ratio applied to the read — values > 1 raise pitch, < 1 lower it

name: Clipper4
description: Four-times oversampled hard clipper. Clips the input to the lo/hi range with internal upsampling to suppress aliasing typically introduced by hard clipping. From sc3-plugins BerlachUGens.

name: Clipper8
description: Eight-times oversampled hard clipper. Same behaviour as Clipper4 with deeper internal oversampling for further reduced aliasing — at the cost of additional CPU. From sc3-plugins BerlachUGens.

name: SoftClipper4
description: Four-times oversampled cubic soft clipper. Applies a smooth saturating transfer function with internal upsampling — much cleaner than SuperCollider's stock .softclip when driven hard. From sc3-plugins BerlachUGens.

name: SoftClipper8
description: Eight-times oversampled cubic soft clipper. Same behaviour as SoftClipper4 with deeper oversampling for the cleanest possible saturation — at higher CPU cost. From sc3-plugins BerlachUGens.

name: SoftClipAmp4
description: Four-times oversampled soft-clipping amplifier. Combines a pregain stage with the SoftClipper4 transfer function — useful as an inline drive/saturation effect. From sc3-plugins BerlachUGens.

inputs.name: pregain
inputs.description: Gain applied to the signal before the soft-clip stage

name: SoftClipAmp8
description: Eight-times oversampled soft-clipping amplifier. Combines a pregain stage with the SoftClipper8 transfer function for the smoothest oversampled drive in the pack. From sc3-plugins BerlachUGens.

inputs.name: pregain
inputs.description: Gain applied to the signal before the soft-clip stage

name: OSWrap4
description: Four-times oversampled wrap. Wraps the signal cyclically into the lo/hi range — values outside the range fold around the bounds with phase continuity. The oversampling reduces aliasing artefacts from the hard wrap discontinuity. From sc3-plugins BerlachUGens.

name: OSWrap8
description: Eight-times oversampled wrap. Same behaviour as OSWrap4 with deeper oversampling for further reduced aliasing of the wrap discontinuity. From sc3-plugins BerlachUGens.

name: OSFold4
description: Four-times oversampled fold. Reflects the signal back into the lo/hi range — produces classic wavefolding distortion (cf. Buchla 259) with internal oversampling to suppress the aliasing typical of folders. From sc3-plugins BerlachUGens.

name: OSFold8
description: Eight-times oversampled fold. Same wavefolding behaviour as OSFold4 with deeper oversampling — useful when driving the folder hard with bright sources. From sc3-plugins BerlachUGens.

name: OSTrunc4
description: Four-times oversampled bit/amplitude truncation (quantizer). Rounds the input to multiples of quant, producing chunky stair-step distortion with reduced aliasing compared to a naive sample-rate quantize. From sc3-plugins BerlachUGens.

inputs.name: quant
inputs.description: Quantization step size — input is rounded to multiples of this value

name: OSTrunc8
description: Eight-times oversampled amplitude truncation (quantizer). Same behaviour as OSTrunc4 with deeper oversampling for cleaner stair-step distortion. From sc3-plugins BerlachUGens.

inputs.name: quant
inputs.description: Quantization step size — input is rounded to multiples of this value

name: DriveNoise
description: Drive-dependent noise injector. Mixes amplitude-correlated noise into the signal — louder input adds proportionally more noise, modelling the noise floor of overdriven analogue stages. From sc3-plugins BerlachUGens.

inputs.name: amount
inputs.description: Noise amount — scales the level of the injected noise

inputs.name: multi
inputs.description: Drive multiplier — controls how strongly input level couples into the noise generator

name: PeakEQ4
description: Four-times oversampled peaking parametric EQ. Boosts or cuts a single resonant peak with reduced aliasing on the resonance — useful when sweeping or modulating at audio rate. From sc3-plugins BerlachUGens.

inputs.name: freq
inputs.description: Centre frequency of the peak in Hertz

inputs.name: rs
inputs.description: Reciprocal of Q — bandwidth of the peak (smaller is narrower)

inputs.name: db
inputs.description: Gain at the peak in decibels (negative cuts, positive boosts)

name: PeakEQ2
description: Two-times oversampled peaking parametric EQ. Same topology as PeakEQ4 with lighter oversampling — a good balance between aliasing rejection and CPU. From sc3-plugins BerlachUGens.

inputs.name: freq
inputs.description: Centre frequency of the peak in Hertz

inputs.name: rs
inputs.description: Reciprocal of Q — bandwidth of the peak (smaller is narrower)

inputs.name: db
inputs.description: Gain at the peak in decibels (negative cuts, positive boosts)
